answer: In PoA, every identity locks bonded collateral, and proof linking k coordinated signatures triggers a correlated-equivocation penalty of O(k^2), rather than k separate linear fines. Once detected, the sybil swarm also faces asymmetric capital depreciation whose compounding multiplier makes aggregate loss exponential in swarm size. Splitting stake is therefore uneconomic: the vine, pigment, and shale of fabricated plurality remain jointly attributable.
